import tkinter as tk
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

class Hydra:
    def __init__(self):
        self.popup = tk.Tk()
        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)

    def run_with_popup(self):
        # Create tkinter widgets
        self.popup.title("Hydra")
        self.status_label = tk.Label(self.popup, text="Status: idle")
        self.status_label.pack()

        # Start background thread
        self.executor.submit(self._run_stages_async)

        # Enter main event loop
        self.popup.mainloop()

    def _run_stages_async(self):

            # Run pipeline stages
            results = []
            for stage in self.pipeline_stages:
                result = stage.run()
                results.append(result)

            self.update_status("Status: complete")
        except Exception as e:
            self.update_status(f"Error: {e}")

    def update_status(self, status):
        self.status_label.config(text=status)
        self.popup.update_idletasks()
